reviewedBy: Codex AfroTools fuel finder release reviewer
reason: Reviewed the protected fuel-engine change and three generated related-tools route changes. The fuel engine preserves the existing generator-cost and legacy row-usability behavior while adding deterministic Haversine nearest-market selection, a fixed 3.785411784 litre US-gallon conversion, tank-level fill quantity, and price-times-litres fill cost. Focused unit and browser fixtures cover these new calculations and do not change any existing golden expected value. The eTIMS, SARS eFiling, and Transfer Pricing route diffs only replace generated related-tool recommendations; their tax and regulatory calculations, rates, thresholds, parameters, rounding, and fixture expectations are unchanged.
